messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Shiny with salesforce and canvas
parts:
Apparently to get a webapp working with salesforce and canvas the webapp needs to handle a post request. Salesforce call your app making a POST request, sending a "signed_request" parameter that is a big base64 encoded String in which all session infos are stored. Would this be something a shiny app would be able to
receive and decode?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny with salesforce and canvas
parts:
Sorry, it's not possible right now for two reasons: 1) we block anything but GET requests on your app's root URL, and 2) even if the POST was made, your server.R file would not have access to the body.

Can you talk a little more about your scenario? What are you trying to build and what do you need from Salesforce Canvas? Maybe we can find a workaround.

receive and decode?

messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Re: Shiny with salesforce and canvas
parts:
Hi Joe,

I am trying to have a shiny app running on the salesforce platform. Authentication is carried out by
salesforce sending a POST request to the webapp in question. This contains a base 64 encoded block of text that
allows authentication to be carried out using some bespoke salesforce javascript https://github.com/forcedotcom/SalesforceCanvasJavascriptSDK .
The webapp then runs on salesforce in an iframe but is treated as a local app and can access as the logged in saleforce user.

I had a look thru the shiny code things have changed since 0.80999... In shiny 0.80999 you were passing any non GET request to NULL in
shinyUI.
It seems now you have middleware and handlers. Would it not be possible for a basic handler to pass a POST request to the shiny app


Cheers

John
